_why: PLAN-003: the Proposal states each milestone's deliverable in PROSE, in a table. This file is that
prose turned into something a command can decide.
`criteria` names checklist items that must be `done`. Every id is checked against
`tools/backlog.json`, so a typo or a renamed item is a failure rather than a silently ignored line.
`external` names what the milestone needs from a party outside this repository. A milestone with a
non-empty `external` list CANNOT pass, however many criteria are met -- that is the point. M7 and M10
each need a commissioned security audit, and a checker that let them pass would be manufacturing the
false confidence DOD-004 and DOD-020 exist to prevent.
`delivers` quotes the Proposal so a reader can see what was translated and judge whether the
translation is faithful. It is NOT checked -- a criterion list can be complete and still wrong about
the milestone, and only a reader can catch that.

M0.delivers: Repo, CI, PRINCIPLES.md, licence, workspace skeleton, xref checker, ADR process

M1.delivers: Load a hand-written component; call a host function; enforce memory + fuel + epoch; trap taxonomy

M2.delivers: Manifest -> grants -> linker; `qqqai inspect` produces a static capability report

M3.delivers: `qqqai serve` runs a real component over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2; streaming bodies; TLS

M4.delivers: `qqqai new/build/run/dev`; hot reload tier 1; error catalogue v1

M5.delivers: AssemblyScript and Go pass the conformance suite. The make-or-break milestone for the multi-language claim.

M6.delivers: `qqqai add/install`, lockfile, registry MVP, capability diff

M7.delivers: Security audit #1 complete; benchmark suite published; first external users

external.why: a second party must perform it; this repository cannot audit itself
a population that does not exist until the private alpha is offered

M9.delivers: `qqqai mcp`, `schema --all`, agent cookbook, migration tool v1

M10.delivers: Docs, installers, registry public, two reference apps, security audit #2

external.why: a second party must perform it
PKG-006 builds it; publishing it needs a host outside this workstation

M11.delivers: Stability guarantees in force, deprecation policy published, governance published
